audit_scope: Faculty & Class Advisor Portal Live Device Debugging & Repair

defect_inventory_resolution.title: Duplicate GlobalKey ink renderer conflict and RenderFlex 99,890px overflow in Quick Access cards
defect_inventory_resolution.root_cause: GlassCard without onTap did not wrap in Material. Sibling buttons (TextButton & ElevatedButton) inside Row registered ink splashes with distant ancestor Scaffold _InkFeatures, causing key collision during layout. When layout failed, Flutter replaced card with ErrorWidget causing 99,890px horizontal overflow.
defect_inventory_resolution.resolution: Enhanced GlassCard to wrap in local transparent Material(type: MaterialType.transparency) when onTap is null. Provided unique ValueKey for each card and set enableBlur: false on side-by-side cards.

defect_inventory_resolution.title: Failed to interpolate TextStyles with different inherit values on theme toggle
defect_inventory_resolution.root_cause: darkTheme omitted textButtonTheme and defined un-inherited TextStyle instances, causing AnimatedTheme 200ms lerp to abort with assertion error when interpolating between inherit: true and inherit: false.
defect_inventory_resolution.resolution: Added matching textButtonTheme and derived all darkTheme button, input, and bottom nav styles from AppTypography tokens with inherit: true.

defect_inventory_resolution.title: Faculty marked attendance not reflected in Student Subject Breakdown
defect_inventory_resolution.root_cause: 1. StudentService parsed date_wise from API response but discarded response['subjects']. 2. StudentAttendanceReportScreen only fetched data if dateWise was empty. 3. AttendancePolicyEngine filtered subjects strictly by student.class_id.
defect_inventory_resolution.resolution: Updated StudentService to populate _subjects and recalculate summary; refreshed on initState in StudentAttendanceReportScreen; merged elective subjects in policy engine.

defect_inventory_resolution.title: 24-hour military timestamps displayed on faculty schedule and attendance screens
defect_inventory_resolution.root_cause: Timetable and attendance screens displayed raw 24-hour HH:MM strings.
defect_inventory_resolution.resolution: Created TimezoneUtils.format24hTo12h() in Flutter and format_time_12h() in timetable_engine.py. Rebuilt lock reasons ('10:50 AM', '2:30 PM') and schedule cards.

defect_inventory_resolution.title: Excessive specular glare and over-bright borders in dark theme
defect_inventory_resolution.root_cause: Overly bright borders (0x4D) and specular glass gradients (0.35 opacity white shine).
defect_inventory_resolution.resolution: Softened dark borders to 0x1F, reduced specular glare from 0.35 to 0.12. Light theme 100% untouched.

defect_inventory_resolution.title: Faculty Dashboard and Timetable App Bar Title Ellipsis Truncation
defect_inventory_resolution.root_cause: Dense header action icon row caused 'Faculty Dashboard' to truncate as 'Faculty D...'.
defect_inventory_resolution.resolution: Applied compact VisualDensity, reduced margins, and 16sp font for app bar title.
